newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia prints 5.8 trillion roubles in February.
newsitem.headline: Russia prints 5.8 trillion roubles in February.

text.p: Russia printed 5.81 trillion roubles in cash in February after withdrawing 7.83 trillion from circulation the previous month, Interfax news agency quoted State Statistics Committee officials as saying.
It said the amount withdrawn from circulation in January was a record high. The central bank printed no money in January.
Interfax said that a new system for calculating monetary supply which the central bank began using this year did not allow year-on-year comparisons.
Russia issued the most cash last year in June, when it printed 10.48 trillion roubles, and in December, when it printed 10.22 trillion roubles.
Russia, which has had great success in taming inflation, has promised not to print too much money and to adhere to the expenditure and revenue targets of its federal budget.
